title: Public utility
idea: Public utility: The permitted public action is immediately clear, with privacy and recovery information close to the control.
audience: People who need to use public action within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: People arrive under time pressure with little product context.
avoidWhen: Brand spectacle would delay a necessary action.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its use public action priority and explicit commitment contract: Display success only for confirmed request delivery or actual connection state.
navigation: Public utility keeps the current use public action context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: The permitted public action is immediately clear, with privacy and recovery information close to the control.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to use public action; people arrive under time pressure with little product context.
composition.priority: Display success only for confirmed request delivery or actual connection state.

imagery.role: Support the actual use public action context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use large readable actions and keep emergency guidance distinct from ordinary requests.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the public utility structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no use public action content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Display success only for confirmed request delivery or actual connection state.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized use public action content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Display success only for confirmed request delivery or actual connection state.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active use public action context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
